author: potuz
content: These are incompatible statements: if you do validate over gossip than that's a Dos waiting to happen. I'm a proposer and send 1000 blocks based on 1000 different combinations. If you don't then you can't do what the spec does that was always a form issue IMO: we have had the same issue with DA and equivocations before, forkchoice needs to know of the existence of objects but the standard setters don't work cause they block them from entering forkchoice. Prysm always had special separate setters for this situation, cheap signature check is enough to send that info to forkchoice without full import, but in this case it does lend to an attack either way so I decided to raise it here. I think prysm approach is the right one regardless of the above attack. If we only record on valid blocks then I think the builder anyway can game the equivocations check and the weak head check on forkchoice or subject clients to dos to verify them.
